harness.note: unchanged since 3d36d03 (P5.3 reviewed version); no local modifications; playwright-core, pixelmatch and pngjs present, so npm ci was not needed

facts.rawHarnessStatus: fail in all 3 runs (21 / 11 / 18 flagged). Every flag traces to the container's agent proxy intermittently failing CONNECT tunnels to www.growmax.io:443 and returning a synthesized 502 'upstream request failed' (text/plain), not to Vercel.

proxyRootCause.agentProxyStatus: recentRelayFailures lists repeated ws_closed_mid_exchange for host www.growmax.io:443 ('517 B sent, 39 B received'), during and between the runs, starting at 09:02Z. The same failure appears for no other site the harness used.
proxyRootCause.b502ScreenshotContent: The B document screenshots that failed (for example visual/b-privacy-desktop.png) show only the plain text 'upstream request failed', which is the proxy's body. The 'Refused to execute script ... MIME type text/plain' console errors are that same 502 body served in place of a JS chunk.
proxyRootCause.sameEdgeControl: Through the proxy, 12 GETs of /privacy each: growmax-website.vercel.app 12/12 200, growmax.replit.app 12/12 200, www.growmax.io 11/12 200 (1 transport error). An earlier 75-request proxy loop to www.growmax.io also produced connection resets and TLS SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL errors.
proxyRootCause.directControl: Without the proxy (--noproxy, normal DNS to 216.150.1.1): 12/12 200 for /privacy. All 31 distinct first-party URLs that failed or returned 502 on B in any run answer 200 directly with the correct content-type (6 application/javascript, 1 text/css, 4 font/woff2, 4 image/png, 1 application/json, 15 text/html).

facts.pixelCoverage: 20/20 page/viewport pairs have at least one comparable capture at or below 0.5%. 16/20 have at least one run that is fully clean (at or below 0.5% and no new B errors). The other 4 (home, revenue-platform, blog-index and comparison, all desktop) were at or below 0.5% (maximum 0.19%) but always had at least one proxy-502 subresource.

inBand0_5to3pct.inspected: a/b/diff PNGs read. Header, featured post, filters and footer match. A (growmax.replit.app) listed 163 articles and B listed 172; B's grid starts with 9 newer posts dated Sep 22-25, which also moves the pagination to 10 pages. This is data freshness on the stale A side (post-cutover posts are on Neon). Runs 2 and 3: 0.02% and 0.001%.
diff PNG read: only glyph differences in one font face. The same run had a proxy 502 on /_next/static/media/d3ebbfd689654d3a-s.p.woff2 (fallback font). Runs 1 and 2: 0.0.

facts.sizeMismatchNotRun: Every size-mismatch capture on B was the 1440x900 or 390x844 proxy 'upstream request failed' page, or a font or CSS 502 that changed the page height. Each of those pairs passed in another run.

residualKeys.key: firstparty|*|<any B URL>|502 or net::ERR_ABORTED following a 502
residualKeys.explanation: The agent proxy synthesized 502 'upstream request failed'. All 31 URLs answer 200 directly (see directControl). Class: env.
Next.js RSC prefetch cancelled at page teardown, the P5.3/P6.2 residual class. Tokens are build-specific, so A (a different build) never produces the same key. All of them answer 200 directly.
Analytics beacons aborted at teardown; this is timing-dependent and seen on A in P5.3. Direct GET of collect returns 204. Not a site defect.

residualKeys.key: console 'Failed to load resource ... 404' on privacy/desktop and demo/desktop when the document itself was a proxy 502
residualKeys.explanation: The browser fetched /favicon.ico for the plain proxy error page. /favicon.ico is 404 on both A and B directly (the site uses /favicon.png).
